name: math-comments
description: Renders LaTeX written inside code comments ($...$, $$...$$, \(...\), \[...\]) directly in the editor.

mathComments.enabled.description: Render LaTeX ($...$, $$...$$, \(...\), \[...\]) written inside code comments.

mathComments.scale.description: Size of rendered math relative to the editor font (formulas taller than their lines are still scaled down to fit).

mathComments.hoverScale.description: Size of the formula in the hover, relative to the editor font.

mathComments.color.description: Colour of rendered math, e.g. #cccccc. Empty: the editor foreground of the active theme kind.

mathComments.maxFileChars.description: Files larger than this are not scanned.
